# Relay — LLM provider runtime for Go

Relay is a host-neutral provider runtime. It owns credentials, catalog/route
resolution, provider transports, normalized request/response streams, retries,
fallback and usage. Hosts (Decoder, etc.) import exactly four packages:
engine, llm, graph, tools. Everything else is engine-internal.

## Start here
- README.md — overview, supported providers, architecture
- AGENTS.md — design principles, conventions, pitfalls, API patterns, testing
- docs/architecture/HOST-ENGINE-BOUNDARY.md — frozen host-facing contract
- docs/guides/CREDENTIAL-SETUP-FLOW.md — API keys and credentials store
- engine/ — stable host facade (engine/provider.go re-exports llm types)
- llm/ — host-facing DTOs (RelayMessage, RelayResponse, RelayTool, RelayUsage)
- graph/ — portable execution graph vocabulary
- tools/ — tool call/result contracts
- provider/ — runtime composition root (internal)
- catalog/ — model catalog, discovery, pricing
- credentials/ — API key storage and safe projection
- router/, runtime/ — route policy and resolution

## Tests and CI
- `go test ./...` (46 packages)
- `make ci` — gofmt, goimports, vet, golangci-lint, boundary checks, race tests, govulncheck
- provider/testkit — mock providers for offline tests (needs multi-turn scripted recorder, see Decoder adoption plan PR3)

## Conventions
- Go 1.27.2+, pure Go, no CGO
- gofumpt formatting, Conventional Commits
- boundary protected by engine/host_surface_test.go (touching unreachable set breaks CI)
